entries.commit_subject: release: regenerate Campaign with certified science — released digest now equals certified b9e3f00c (decision 0025, option A part 1)
entries.rationale: The decision-0025 option A regeneration. The shipped Campaign is rebuilt to carry the certified science, and the climb, catalog and ReleaseCore that name it follow. Exactly seven scientific values change: subject provider development -> prime, model_id development-placeholder -> qwen/qwen3.7-flash, credential_env TECHTREE_MODEL_API_KEY -> PRIME_API_KEY, maximum_output_tokens null -> 8000, maximum_usd null -> 1.00, execution order sequential -> parallel variants, max_concurrent 1 -> 4. Task membership, taskset, scoring, sampling, runtime image, data policy and both Skill digests are untouched. The regenerated Campaign is digest-identical to b9e3f00c, the campaign every certified run's signed proof names. Certified by the three re-certification runs of Gate-1 addendum 1 §A1.4.
